metadata.title: Japan Regional Snowfall & Winter Climate Analysis Across ENSO Phases (1953/54–2024/25)
metadata.analysis_period: 1953/54 to 2024/25 (72 winters: 19 El Niño, 19 La Niña, 34 Neutral)
metadata.enso_definition: JMA NINO.3 (5°S–5°N, 150°W–90°W) SST deviation from latest sliding 30-year mean, 5-month running mean >= +0.5°C (El Niño) or <= -0.5°C (La Niña) for >= 6 consecutive months.
